body.label: Target
body.html: A connected line of up to 3 empty spaces within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Concentration: form a temporary waist-high wall, granting +1 cover across it. Each space has 2 Wounds and 0 Resilience. It lasts up to 3 rounds; creatures can cross a space as difficult terrain.

surges.html: One space may provide full cover, but then blocks movement until destroyed.
Up to two willing creatures beside the wall reduce their next incoming Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Earth Thread
rider.html: Gain an Earth Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: yourself or one willing target of that card reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 before the start of your next turn.
